mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sales (sales_date, store_code, product_code, quantity, unit_price, amount, line_no) VALUES (#{salesDate}, #{storeCode}, #{productCode}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{amount}, #{lineNo})
mapper.select: SELECT store_code, FORMATDATETIME(sales_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS sales_month, SUM(amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS sales_count FROM sales GROUP BY store_code, FORMATDATETIME(sales_date, 'yyyy-MM') ORDER BY store_code, sales_month
